description: Start of the loop: boot headless emulators (1-3 min). No args = ONE device (s24ultra, newest API <= 36), the right choice for building/checking an app; count > 1 mixes Galaxy profiles and Android versions. How many: 1 to build/check an app; 2-3 to reproduce multi-user bugs (duplicate / lost / overwritten records); one per screen or Android version you must check (or name them with profiles). Each device takes about 1.5 GB of host RAM; a count the available RAM cannot hold fails before booting and says how many fit. Returns {devices:[{serial, api, profile, wmSize}]}; pass serial to every other tool.

allowNoHelper.description: true = keep the devices when the on-device helper fails (screen/tap/type then use the slower uiautomator/input)

idleMinutes.description: devices stop after this many minutes without a crewdroid call, and when this MCP server exits (default 60; 0 = never)

load.description: used-phone load applied after boot (see the load tool)

wifi.description: true = each device can get its own Wi-Fi address (31 of 33 measured device boots; default: one device at a time; +9.4 % idle RAM)

name: up
